passages.text: Leaving the track and gaining a lasting advantage.

passages.text: Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV Article 2 c) of the FIA International Sporting Code and Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.

passages.label: Reason, sentence 2
passages.text: Following the incident in Turn 4, Verstappen attempted to pass Norris on the inside at Turn 8.

passages.label: Reason, sentence 3
passages.text: Verstappen was ahead at the apex of Turn 8 and would have been entitled to racing room.

passages.label: Reason, sentence 4
passages.text: However, he was not able to complete the maneuver on the track, left the track and kept the lasting advantage gaining the position, incidently forcing Norris off the track.

passages.label: Reason, sentence 5
passages.text: The penalty is the standard penalty for leaving the track and gaining a lasting advantage.

passages.label: Fact
passages.text: Forcing another driver off the track.

passages.label: Infringement
passages.text: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.

passages.label: Decision
passages.text: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 6 for the 12 month period).

passages.label: Reason, sentence 2
passages.text: Norris was attempting to overtake on the outside of Verstappen at Turn 4.

passages.label: Reason, sentence 3
passages.text: Norris was ahead of Verstappen at the entry, apex and towards the exit of the turn when he started being forced off the track.

passages.label: Reason, sentence 4
passages.text: The Stewards believe that the maneuver was done in a safe and controlled manner and that Norris would have been able to make the maneuver on the track had he not been forced off the track by Verstappen.

passages.label: Reason, sentence 6
passages.text: The penalty is the standard penalty in such cases.
